value: Test-Time Training (MIT 2025) by Akyürek, Damani, Kim, Andreas. Temporarily updates model parameters DURING deployment using task-specific examples. Creates mini-dataset via data augmentation, fine-tunes via low-rank adaptation. Result: 6x accuracy boost on novel reasoning tasks. Temporary updates (revert after task) or permanent via SEAL integration. Enables instant specialization: unfamiliar task → expert in 5-10 minutes.
